title: One silver container. One identity.
summary: Approve one static identity master, its material roles and a local parametric 3D construction method before production.
motion_use: The same rigid, closed-door container moves through lift pickup, camera pivot, trailer support and ship placement. Keep its dimensions, corrugation, material and attachment landmarks consistent; doors do not need animation.

dimensions.scope: Nominal external envelope only; hardware detail and finish remain proposed visual design.

inputs.view: Three-quarter oblique at approximately mid-height, showing the closed double-door end and one full long side, with a small roof edge visible; no overhead perspective.
inputs.purpose: Establish the silver finish, long-side corrugation, door hardware and corner-casting identity together. The regular container envelope is constructed from dimensions, so separate side/end images are not needed for the proposed method.
inputs.output: One transparent landscape PNG with the complete silhouette and comfortable margins; final supported canvas size is checked before submission.

input_change_rule: If the approved master leaves a necessary detail unresolved, document the specific gap and request approval for that input before generating it.

materials.part: Corrugated walls, roof, closed doors and structural frame
materials.finish: Cool brushed silver with a restrained satin sheen and fine consistent grain; no mirror finish or warm tint.
materials.approval: Silver identity is agreed; this specific finish is proposed for review in the static master.

materials.part: Corner castings, hinges, locking rods and handles
materials.finish: Neutral silver/titanium hardware, subtly distinct from the wall finish; readable solid metal geometry.
Natural dark matte rubber; narrow functional seams.
materials.approval: Proposed rubber role; no painted trim or additional colorway.

materials.part: Any explicitly selected painted carbon fittings
materials.finish: Pegasoft carbon #11151B, shared satin structural finish wherever used.
materials.approval: Color authority is agreed; no carbon-painted component is required by this proposal.

lighting: Even cool studio lighting with restrained #7BCBFF and #B9E7FF reflections. Blue is illumination, not a new painted panel. Carbon #11151B and porcelain #EDF2F7 are review backgrounds only.
mandatory_carbon_clause: All painted carbon or graphite surfaces use Pegasoft carbon #11151B as their shared base paint color. Graphite describes the material appearance; do not introduce a separate grey-blue paint variant. Preserve the separately approved blue, brushed silver/titanium, rubber and glass material roles. Natural highlights and shadows come from lighting, not different paint colors.
reviewed_prompt: The same premium silver 40-foot high-cube ISO shipping container, brushed metal corrugated walls, consistent corner castings and believable steel hardware. Three-quarter oblique at approximately mid-height, showing the closed double-door end and one full long side, with only a small roof edge visible; no overhead/roof-only or underside plate. Maintain nominal external proportions of 12.192 m length, 2.438 m width and 2.896 m height. Corrugated walls, roof, doors and structural frame have cool brushed silver with a restrained satin sheen and fine consistent grain. Corner castings, hinges, locking rods and handles are neutral silver/titanium metal; door seals are natural dark matte rubber. Isolated on transparency with comfortable margin, crisp realistic edges and restrained blue-tinted specular light in #7BCBFF and #B9E7FF. Maintain identical dimensions and structural details across later model views. No text, serial number, logo, baked shadow, yellow/gold glow, dents that change between views or scene background. No additional painted blue or carbon panel is requested. All painted carbon or graphite surfaces use Pegasoft carbon #11151B as their shared base paint color. Graphite describes the material appearance; do not introduce a separate grey-blue paint variant. Preserve the separately approved blue, brushed silver/titanium, rubber and glass material roles. Natural highlights and shadows come from lighting, not different paint colors.

model_method.method: Local parametric solid geometry in the existing Three.js review runtime, exported as GLB after static-master approval.
model_method.provider: Local construction; no external 3D generation provider.
model_method.rationale: A regular container can keep exact proportions, complete surfaces and stable attachment points with one identity reference. Build corrugation and hardware as geometry rather than wrapping image facades around a box.
construction: Build volumetric corrugated panels, roof, floor, end wall, closed doors, frame, corner castings and hardware with consistent thickness and joins.
Keep casting apertures and door seams as intentional physical details; audit closed solid components across material partitions for defects.
Derive unseen surfaces from the same dimensions and repeated construction, then show them in model review rather than generating more plates.
Use procedural brushed-metal material detail fitted to the approved master, without baked camera lighting or generated lettering.
Keep one named container root, Y-up orientation, X along its length and origin at the base center. Derive pickup and support landmarks from actual geometry.
model_method.limitation: The static master guides appearance; it does not recover hidden geometry. Unseen construction and final material parameters require interactive model approval.

approval_sequence: Approve this one-image input set, material roles and local model method; separately authorize the bounded non-lift production allowance.
Verify current Image 2.5 endpoint, valid output settings, transparency and price; submit one C01 image. Obtain user review on carbon and porcelain before modeling. No automatic variants or retries.

After static approval, construct the model and present orbit/zoom, both ends, both sides, roof and hardware on both review surfaces. Check dimensions, solid components, surface consistency and usable GLB before final model approval.

Integrate a separate derivative with the accepted lift. Review actual casting pickup/contact, full load silhouette, settling, camera pivot and genuine forward/reverse restoration; preserve the accepted lift originals.
Review trailer/deck support transfer and final section framing when their families exist; do not infer their acceptance from the container or diagnostic proxy.

spending.requested_batch: One C01 Image 2.5 master; stop for static review. No automatic correction, additional image, model production or next-family dispatch.
spending.price_check: Pending at the generation gate; no exact credit cap can be promised without a usable meter.

approval_requested: Approve the one oblique master, proposed silver/hardware/rubber finishes and local solid-geometry method. Confirm an allowance extension for the single-image batch before any paid generation.
